name: crush
description: Tool-output compressor (crush 2). Classifies every tool result and applies only transforms that passed a token, accuracy and edit-safety gate: identical-line runs written once with a counted note (lossless); progress redraws and blobs too when the raw is kept (--keep-raw-dir). File views, diffs and grep hits are never changed. Pass-through on any doubt.
author: Jawz

commands.name: crush
commands.description: Report how many tokens crush has saved this session (estimated).
